snippet.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 redefines the franchise with a reality-shattering Co-Op Campaign, adrenaline-fueled Multiplayer across 18 launch maps, and the chilling return of Round-Based Zombies. Embrace the madness and experience the most mind-bending Black Ops yet.
